alternatives.name: VERSIONED_INFLUENCE_EVENT_IDENTITY
tradeoffs: Social edits and deletions require version history and storage.

decision.summary: Public influence events bind immutable event identity, content versions, first_observed_at, and edit/delete lineage. Research uses observable content at decision time, not final post state.
decision.title: Public influence event identity and versioning

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status does not authorize social API connections, ingestion, or influence-driven trading.
